summary: POMDOCTOR Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a change in its ADS ratio from 1 ADS representing 1/6 Class A ordinary share to 1 ADS representing 3 Class A ordinary shares, effective June 22, 2026. This is functionally a 1-for-18 reverse ADS split. No new shares are issued or cancelled; fractional ADSs will be sold and proceeds distributed. The ticker symbol remains POM. This is an ordinary corporate action to adjust the ADS price, not a special situation.
